close_reason: All local durable multi-turn and multi-tool coding interaction phases are complete. Brew, signing, notarization, publication, and daemon work remain out of scope.
description: Cross-repository Jidoka and jido_cli work to support durable multi-turn coding sessions, native and fallback multi-tool loops, recovery, an interactive TUI, and exact local-artifact validation. title: Ship durable multi-turn, multi-tool coding interactions
